name: Favela Mágica
overview: In a world divided between the City of the Skies, home to humans, and Favela Mágica, a vibrant territory inhabited by magical beings, young witch apprentice Sasha gets involved in mystical mysteries and adventures alongside Arthur, a maned werewolf who hides a secret about his true identity. Blending magic, music, and battles, the series uses fantasy to reflect reality while exploring themes of belonging, ancestry, and inequality.
